messages:
deploy-bot: Canary promote stopped for billing-service chart=billing-chart image.tag=v2.8.0 in us-east-1. Health check failures -> migration job crash. Asking eng-releases for rollback vs patch.

lia: Looking at pod logs, migration container exits with SIGABRT during startup.

tom: Recent chart change bumped `migrations.parallel` from 2->6. Could be the culprit.

sre-oncall: Change window still open. My recommendation: rollback canary subset to v2.7.4 and pin until we cut a hotfix that reduces parallelism and adds backoff.

release-coordinator: Agreed. Plan: rollback canary, create lock, open hotfix PR with `migrations.parallel=2` and `migrations.backoff=true`. Also add release notes.

lia: Rolling back canary now: `helm upgrade billing-prod billing-chart --namespace prod --set image.tag=v2.7.4 --set canary.traffic=0.05 --reuse-values`. Creating lock billing-service@v2.7.4.

deploy-bot: Lock created: `billing-service@v2.7.4` (reason: canary migration crash). Staged promotes halted. Lock URL: https://deploy/locks/55555

sre-oncall: Monitoring — canary pods stabilized, readiness healthy. I'll watch metrics for 15m.

tom: I'll open the chart PR and include a smoke test that runs migrations with reduced parallelism in a staging cluster. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/999

release-coordinator: After PR merge, promote with tiny traffic (0.5%) and migration flags: `migrations.enabled=true,migrations.parallel=1,migrations.backoff=true`. Keep lock until validated.

lia: No customer-facing errors reported beyond transient retries. Drafting release note now.

deploy-bot: Event log: rollback-complete, lock-created. No automatic promotes until lock cleared.
